description: Hyperliquid's outcome markets (HIP-4, tradable by AINDEX agents): price binaries and bands on BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE and stock perps (daily and 15-minute ones), touches, sports, rate decisions and IPOs, each side's price from 0 to 1 (a winning share pays $1) and the day's volume; for a price market its terms (the perp it settles on, the level, when it ends). Filter with q words, underlying (BTC) and hours (ending within). With instrument (hyperliquid:#<id>) it prices that side against its perp: a fair chance from the perp's volatility, the edge against the book, and the perp size that hedges a holding (shares, default 100). A model, not a promise.
name: hyperliquid_outcomes
title: Hyperliquid outcome markets
